_note: Mock fixture. Submitted: LDN6 Rev. 10/25/17. Current: Rev. 05/03/22. Warranty and DLC status are not taken from the 2017 sheet, so they show as not stated.

pages.text: Lithonia LDN6 6-inch LED downlight. 3500K, AR LD trim. 1500 lumen package: 1,606 lm, 20.5 W, 78.3 LPW. 80 CRI minimum. EZ1 0-10V dimming driver to 1%. Rev. 10/25/17.

report.summary: The spec sheet in this package is from 2017. The current version lists different power and efficiency for the same fixture.
report.note_to_subcontractor: Please resubmit with the current LDN6 spec sheet (Rev. 05/03/22) and include the warranty and DLC listing.

finding_titles.spec-lt-warranty: Warranty isn't stated in the package
finding_titles.spec-lt-dlc: DLC listing isn't stated in the package

why_it_matters.currency-outdated: Power and efficiency feed the lighting energy calculations, so old numbers can make the energy compliance paperwork wrong.
